summary: This 8-K reports shareholder approval of a SPAC business combination, domestication, charter, and organizational proposals at Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V's extraordinary general meeting on June 16, 2026. All nine proposals passed with 20,282,626 votes for the business combination and domestication, and similar majorities for others. Definitive proxy was filed May 27; record date May 7. The SPAC had 28.75M shares outstanding, a de-SPAC transaction is pending. No exact valuation or target disclosed in this filing; the target is not named. Watch for completion timing and potential redemptions.
